_comment: Read by tools/config-reference.py and tools/v1-freeze.py: akit's extensions to fit's config, akit's defaults where fit's hold the name fit (`defaults`: fit's renamed, decision 037), and akit's notes on fields it reads differently from fit, in English and Chinese. Each path is a field of fit's inventory (tests/compat/fit-fields.txt) or an extension; the generator refuses any other.

listeners[].sockmap.en: The connections of the `tcp` services this listener accepts are spliced in the kernel by akio's eBPF sockmap relay where it loads (Linux 6.15 or later, with `CAP_BPF` and `CAP_NET_ADMIN`), and relayed in userspace where it does not. Only for a listener whose protocols include `tcp`. A reload that changes it applies to the connections accepted after it. fit refuses it as an unknown field.
listeners[].sockmap.zh: 该监听器接受的 `tcp` 服务连接，在能加载 akio 的 eBPF sockmap 中继时（Linux 6.15 及以上，具备 `CAP_BPF` 和 `CAP_NET_ADMIN`）在内核中直接拼接，否则在用户态转发。只用于协议包含 `tcp` 的监听器。重载改变它时，只影响此后接受的连接。fit 把它当作未知字段拒绝。
listeners[].sockmap.en_short: a `tcp` listener's connections spliced in the kernel by akio's eBPF sockmap relay where it loads
listeners[].sockmap.zh_short: `tcp` 监听器的连接在能加载 akio 的 eBPF sockmap 中继时于内核中拼接

listeners[].protocols.en: With `h2c` and no `http/1.1` the listener serves HTTP/2 with prior knowledge alone, as fit's (I79b): a client that sends anything else gets akio's `GOAWAY` (`PROTOCOL_ERROR`) before the connection closes, where fit closes it with nothing (akio's ADR-174).
listeners[].protocols.zh: 有 `h2c` 而没有 `http/1.1` 时，监听器只以先验知识提供 HTTP/2，与 fit 相同（I79b）：发送其他内容的客户端会先收到 akio 的 `GOAWAY`（`PROTOCOL_ERROR`）再被关闭连接，而 fit 不发送任何内容直接关闭（akio 的 ADR-174）。

listeners[].tls.kernel_tls_offload.zh: 随 `engine` 的设置一起支持。

admin.address.zh: Unix 套接字（`unix/<路径>`）的权限设为 0600。

admin.token_file.zh: 在 akit 启动时读取。

acme.storage.en: akit's own directory, not fit's: the two do not share accounts or certificates unless `storage` names one.
acme.storage.zh: 不写时为 `$XDG_DATA_HOME/akit` 或 `~/.local/share/akit`：akit 自己的目录，而不是 fit 的；除非 `storage` 指向同一目录，两者不共享账户和证书。

routes[].handler<static>.params.disk_io.en: Only `pool`: akit looks at the disk on akio's file pool, never on an I/O thread, and refuses `auto` as not supported yet.
routes[].handler<static>.params.disk_io.zh: 只接受 `pool`：akit 只在 akio 的文件池上访问磁盘，从不在 I/O 线程上，`auto` 按“尚不支持”拒绝。

routes[].handler<proxy>.params.splice_up.en: Not planned yet: `splice(2)` needs `unsafe` or an akio API.
routes[].handler<proxy>.params.splice_up.zh: 暂无计划：`splice(2)` 需要 `unsafe` 或 akio 的 API。

routes[].middleware[]<wasm>.params.path.en: The plugin runs on akio-wasm's instance pool, never on an I/O thread. akit's ABI is fit's with its names renamed (decision 037): a plugin of fit's is built again with fit's guest package renamed (as tools/plugin-guest.sh does); Proxy-Wasm filters run unchanged.
routes[].middleware[]<wasm>.params.path.zh: 插件在 akio-wasm 的实例池上运行，从不在 I/O 线程上。akit 的 ABI 即 fit 的 ABI 改名之后的版本（决定 037）：fit 的插件需用改名后的 fit guest 包重新构建（如 tools/plugin-guest.sh 所做）；Proxy-Wasm 过滤器无需修改即可运行。

upstreams[].deny_internal.en: It comes with the Kubernetes provider's ExternalName Services (`allow_external_name_services`).
upstreams[].deny_internal.zh: 随 Kubernetes provider 的 ExternalName Service（`allow_external_name_services`）一起支持。

limits.max_write_queue_bytes.en: akio's `max_queued_bytes`: past it akio refuses the write (`Overloaded`) rather than queue it, where fit closes the connection.
limits.max_write_queue_bytes.zh: 即 akio 的 `max_queued_bytes`：超出时 akio 拒绝这次写入（`Overloaded`）而不排队，fit 则关闭连接。

limits.max_pending_bytes.en: akio's budget of the bytes queued across the listeners' engine (akio's ADR-172): past it every connection, upstream ones too, stops reading after its current read, and all resume once the bytes queued are back under three quarters of it. akio sums the I/O threads' queues every millisecond or so, so what is queued meanwhile can pass the budget by a little. A share of memory is read from `/proc/meminfo` and the cgroup's limit on Linux; elsewhere (macOS) akit reads no memory and a share is 256 MiB.
limits.max_pending_bytes.zh: 即 akio 对监听器引擎上所有排队字节的预算（akio 的 ADR-172）：超过后，每个连接（包括到上游的连接）在当前这次读之后停止读，排队字节回落到预算的四分之三以下时全部恢复。akio 大约每毫秒汇总一次各 I/O 线程的队列，所以期间入队的数据可能略微超过预算。内存份额在 Linux 上从 `/proc/meminfo` 和 cgroup 的上限读取；其他系统（macOS）上 akit 读不到内存，份额按 256 MiB 计。

engine.event_loops.en: Each listener's akio I/O threads, which run its connections' callbacks too (fib's loops only wait); one a core when left out or 0, where fib has 1 on up to 4 CPUs.
engine.event_loops.zh: 每个监听器的 akio I/O 线程数，这些线程也运行连接的回调（fib 的事件循环只负责等待）；省略或为 0 时每个核一个，而 fib 在至多 4 个 CPU 上为 1。

engine.workers.en: The most threads of akio's logical pool, which runs only the work that may block (files, plugins, the disk cache), not connections' callbacks; akio's default (8 a core, at least 8) when left out or 0.
engine.workers.zh: akio 逻辑池的最大线程数，它只运行可能阻塞的工作（文件、插件、磁盘缓存），不运行连接的回调；省略或为 0 时为 akio 的默认值（每核 8 个，至少 8 个）。

engine.min_workers.en: The logical pool's threads kept when idle (akio's `min_threads`).
engine.min_workers.zh: 逻辑池空闲时保留的线程数（akio 的 `min_threads`）。

engine.task_queue.en: The jobs akio's logical pool holds waiting for a thread; akio's 65,536 when left out or 0. Past it, new work is refused rather than queued.
engine.task_queue.zh: akio 逻辑池中等待线程的任务数；省略或为 0 时为 akio 的 65,536。超出时新的工作被拒绝，而不排队。

engine.write_watermark.en: akio's `write_high_watermark`; akio's 256 KiB when left out or 0. Reads resume at a quarter of it.
engine.write_watermark.zh: 即 akio 的 `write_high_watermark`；省略或为 0 时为 akio 的 256 KiB。降到其四分之一时恢复读取。

engine.backlog.en: akio's 1024 when left out or 0, not the system's.
engine.backlog.zh: 省略或为 0 时为 akio 的 1024，而不是系统的值。

log.format.en: The formats are fit's, as fib writes them (akio's own log formats are not used): `line` as fib's, `text` and `json` as Go's log/slog.
log.format.zh: 格式与 fit 相同，即 fib 的写法（不使用 akio 自己的日志格式）：`line` 同 fib，`text` 和 `json` 同 Go 的 log/slog。

log.levels.en: `engine` takes akio's records: its warnings and errors at their levels, its info and debug records at debug (fib's engine lines are off unless asked). akit's crates whose messages carry no level (ACME, OCSP, providers, telemetry, FastCGI's stderr) write them at warn. `plugin` has no messages yet.
log.levels.zh: `engine` 接收 akio 的记录：警告和错误保持其级别，info 和 debug 记录按 debug 写（fib 的引擎行默认不输出）。消息不带级别的 akit crate（ACME、OCSP、provider、遥测、FastCGI 的 stderr）按 warn 写。`plugin` 暂无消息。

log.time_zone.en: An IANA name is read from the system's zoneinfo files, as `access_log.time_zone`'s; fit embeds Go's zone database.
log.time_zone.zh: IANA 名称从系统的 zoneinfo 文件读取，与 `access_log.time_zone` 相同；fit 内嵌了 Go 的时区数据库。

admin.console.users[].password_hash.en: `akit hash-password` makes one; fit's hashes are taken as they are.
admin.console.users[].password_hash.zh: 由 `akit hash-password` 生成；fit 的哈希原样可用。

admin.store.en: The file is fit's `fitstore` format, byte for byte (its magic stays `FITSTORE`): fit opens akit's stores and akit fit's, and they run in turn from one. `akit run` keeps the config in it (I93b), merged onto the config files at each start; `akit store export` and `import` read and write it. Without `admin.store`, `akit run -admin` keeps one beside the config file, as fit's (I93c).
admin.store.zh: 文件即 fit 的 `fitstore` 格式，逐字节相同（其魔数仍为 `FITSTORE`）：fit 能打开 akit 的 store，akit 也能打开 fit 的，两者可轮流从同一个 store 运行。`akit run` 把配置保存在其中（I93b），每次启动时合并到配置文件之上；`akit store export` 和 `import` 读写它。没有 `admin.store` 时，`akit run -admin` 同 fit 在配置文件旁边保存一个（I93c）。

admin.cert_file.en: The files are looked at on the control thread every `-watch-interval` with `-watch-certs` (on by default), not at a handshake as fit's, and loaded once they have stayed as they are for 500ms; SIGHUP reads them again too (I94). New connections get the new certificate; files that do not load are logged in the `admin` logger and the running certificate stays.
admin.cert_file.zh: 在控制线程上，带 `-watch-certs`（默认开启）时每个 `-watch-interval` 查看一次这些文件，而不是像 fit 那样在握手时查看；文件保持 500ms 不变后加载；SIGHUP 也会重新读取（I94）。新连接得到新证书；加载失败的文件记录到 `admin` 日志器，正在使用的证书保留。

admin.client_ca_file.en: Read again with `cert_file` (I94): new connections are checked against the new CAs.
admin.client_ca_file.zh: 与 `cert_file` 一起重新读取（I94）：新连接按新的 CA 检查。

admin.console.cert_file.en: Read again when the files change, as `admin.cert_file` (I94): a renewed certificate is served to new connections without a restart; fit reads it when it starts.
admin.console.cert_file.zh: 文件变化时重新读取，与 `admin.cert_file` 相同（I94）：续期的证书无需重启即提供给新连接；fit 只在启动时读取。

tunnel.en: Read and checked as fit's (I98); `akit run` runs the three roles (I101) on the listeners' engine, their links speaking fit's protocol byte for byte, so that akit's hub, nodes and proxies link with fit's (decision 038). Links go over `tcp`, `tls` (I102), `quic` (I102b), and `ws` and `wss` (I102c, on akio-ws). A hub's `console_socket` and a proxy's `web_proxies` speak fit's sealed WebSocket (I103b).
tunnel.zh: 像 fit 一样读取并检查（I98）；`akit run` 在监听器的引擎上运行这三个角色（I101），其链路与 fit 的协议逐字节相同，使 akit 的 hub、node 和 proxy 能与 fit 的互连（决定 038）。链路走 `tcp`、`tls`（I102）、`quic`（I102b），以及 `ws` 和 `wss`（I102c，基于 akio-ws）。hub 的 `console_socket` 和 proxy 的 `web_proxies` 使用 fit 的密封 WebSocket（I103b）。

llm.en: Read and checked as fit's (I98). `akit run` refuses a config that sets a role until the LLM iterations run it (I104–I109).
llm.zh: 像 fit 一样读取并检查（I98）。在 LLM 的迭代运行这些角色之前（I104–I109），`akit run` 拒绝设置了角色的配置。

tunnel.node.hubs[].token.en: akit's tokens are `akitt1.<id>.<secret>` (decision 037); a token fit issued (`fitt1.`) is written with akit's prefix, its ID and secret unchanged (decision 038).
tunnel.node.hubs[].token.zh: akit 的 token 形如 `akitt1.<id>.<secret>`（决定 037）；fit 签发的 token（`fitt1.`）写成 akit 的前缀，其 ID 和 secret 不变（决定 038）。

tunnel.proxy.hubs[].token.en: akit's tokens are `akitt1.<id>.<secret>` (decision 037); a token fit issued (`fitt1.`) is written with akit's prefix, its ID and secret unchanged (decision 038).
tunnel.proxy.hubs[].token.zh: akit 的 token 形如 `akitt1.<id>.<secret>`（决定 037）；fit 签发的 token（`fitt1.`）写成 akit 的前缀，其 ID 和 secret 不变（决定 038）。

llm.hub.peers[].token.en: akit's tokens are `akitt1.<id>.<secret>` (decision 037); a token fit issued (`fitt1.`) is written with akit's prefix, its ID and secret unchanged (decision 038).
llm.hub.peers[].token.zh: akit 的 token 形如 `akitt1.<id>.<secret>`（决定 037）；fit 签发的 token（`fitt1.`）写成 akit 的前缀，其 ID 和 secret 不变（决定 038）。

llm.node.peers[].token.en: akit's tokens are `akitt1.<id>.<secret>` (decision 037); a token fit issued (`fitt1.`) is written with akit's prefix, its ID and secret unchanged (decision 038).
llm.node.peers[].token.zh: akit 的 token 形如 `akitt1.<id>.<secret>`（决定 037）；fit 签发的 token（`fitt1.`）写成 akit 的前缀，其 ID 和 secret 不变（决定 038）。

llm.proxy.peers[].token.en: akit's tokens are `akitt1.<id>.<secret>` (decision 037); a token fit issued (`fitt1.`) is written with akit's prefix, its ID and secret unchanged (decision 038).
llm.proxy.peers[].token.zh: akit 的 token 形如 `akitt1.<id>.<secret>`（决定 037）；fit 签发的 token（`fitt1.`）写成 akit 的前缀，其 ID 和 secret 不变（决定 038）。

tunnel.hub.console.en: `akit run` refuses it until I109 serves the roles' pages; `akit validate` checks it. With it, the hub's `console_socket`, which carries the pages.
tunnel.hub.console.zh: 在 I109 提供角色页面之前 `akit run` 拒绝它；`akit validate` 会检查它。hub 的 `console_socket` 承载这些页面，因此随之被拒绝。

tunnel.node.console.en: `akit run` refuses it until I109 serves the roles' pages; `akit validate` checks it.
tunnel.node.console.zh: 在 I109 提供角色页面之前 `akit run` 拒绝它；`akit validate` 会检查它。

tunnel.proxy.console.en: `akit run` refuses it until I109 serves the roles' pages; `akit validate` checks it.
tunnel.proxy.console.zh: 在 I109 提供角色页面之前 `akit run` 拒绝它；`akit validate` 会检查它。

tunnel.hub.console_socket.en: fit's sealed WebSocket byte for byte (I103b): fit's proxies' web proxies reach akit's hub, and akit's fit's. It dials the hub's `console.address`, which `akit run` refuses until I109 serves the pages there. A WebSocket refused or failed gets a close frame where fit aborts it (akio API request A238).
tunnel.hub.console_socket.zh: 逐字节等同 fit 的密封 WebSocket（I103b）：fit 的 proxy 的 web 代理可连到 akit 的 hub，akit 的也可连到 fit 的。它拨向 hub 的 `console.address`，而在 I109 在那里提供页面之前 `akit run` 拒绝该字段。被拒绝或失败的 WebSocket 收到关闭帧，而 fit 直接中止（akio API 请求 A238）。

tunnel.proxy.web_proxies.en: Run by `akit run` (I103b), sealed as fit's: they serve the consoles of fit's hubs as of akit's. Their WebSockets say `User-Agent: akit`.
tunnel.proxy.web_proxies.zh: 由 `akit run` 运行（I103b），密封方式同 fit：既可提供 fit 的 hub 的控制台，也可提供 akit 的。其 WebSocket 发送 `User-Agent: akit`。

webrtc.en: Read and checked as fit's (I110, decision 039); `akit run` runs `turn` (I111) on the listeners' engine, and refuses `media` (I113) and `proxy` (I114) until their iterations run them.
webrtc.zh: 像 fit 一样读取并检查（I110，决定 039）；`akit run` 在监听器的引擎上运行 `turn`（I111），在 `media`（I113）和 `proxy`（I114）的迭代运行它们之前拒绝它们。

webrtc.turn.en: akio-turn's server (I111): `SOFTWARE` is `akit`; TCP allocations (RFC 6062) are refused with 442, as fit's. The users, secret, peer rules, access and certificates change in place; a change of the quotas, caps or lifetimes starts a new server, as one of the addresses does, until akio-turn changes them in place (A258); the server a reload replaced keeps serving for `-shutdown-timeout`. `/metrics` has `akit_turn_allocations`, `akit_turn_draining_servers`, `akit_turn_relayed_datagrams_total`, `akit_turn_auth_failures_total` and `akit_turn_restarts_total`; fit's bytes and events wait for A257.
webrtc.turn.zh: akio-turn 的服务器（I111）：`SOFTWARE` 为 `akit`；TCP allocation（RFC 6062）以 442 拒绝，同 fit。用户、secret、peer 规则、access 和证书就地修改；配额、上限或生存期的变化与地址的变化一样启动新服务器，直到 akio-turn 能就地修改它们（A258）；被重新加载替换的服务器在 `-shutdown-timeout` 内继续服务。`/metrics` 有 `akit_turn_allocations`、`akit_turn_draining_servers`、`akit_turn_relayed_datagrams_total`、`akit_turn_auth_failures_total` 和 `akit_turn_restarts_total`；fit 的字节数和事件等待 A257。

webrtc.turn.port_min.en: Read and checked; `akit run` refuses a range until akio-turn binds relayed sockets in one (A256).
webrtc.turn.port_min.zh: 读取并检查；在 akio-turn 能在范围内绑定中继套接字之前（A256），`akit run` 拒绝范围。

webrtc.turn.port_max.en: Read and checked; `akit run` refuses a range until akio-turn binds relayed sockets in one (A256).
webrtc.turn.port_max.zh: 读取并检查；在 akio-turn 能在范围内绑定中继套接字之前（A256），`akit run` 拒绝范围。

webrtc.turn.user_bandwidth.en: Not enforced yet, said when the server starts: akio-turn has no hook for a username's relayed bytes (A257).
webrtc.turn.user_bandwidth.zh: 尚不强制执行，服务器启动时会说明：akio-turn 没有按用户名中继字节的钩子（A257）。

webrtc.turn.nonce_secret.en: Not applied yet, said when the server starts: akio-turn keys each server's nonces itself (A256).
webrtc.turn.nonce_secret.zh: 尚不生效，服务器启动时会说明：akio-turn 自行为每个服务器的 nonce 生成密钥（A256）。

webrtc.turn.max_stream_message.en: Not applied yet, said when the server starts: akio-turn's framing takes messages up to 64 KiB (A256).
webrtc.turn.max_stream_message.zh: 尚不生效，服务器启动时会说明：akio-turn 的分帧接受最大 64 KiB 的消息（A256）。

webrtc.turn.mptcp.en: `listen_tcp` and `listen_tls` take plain TCP, as fit on a kernel without Multipath TCP; said when the server starts.
webrtc.turn.mptcp.zh: `listen_tcp` 和 `listen_tls` 使用普通 TCP，如同 fit 在不支持多路径 TCP 的内核上；服务器启动时会说明。

webrtc.turn.allowed_peers.en: `relay_ip` and `public_ip` are reached on the ports listed with them alone, never on the server's relayed ports, until akio-turn tells its relayed addresses (A257): two clients of one server relay to each other through one relayed address and the other's server-reflexive one.
webrtc.turn.allowed_peers.zh: 在 akio-turn 告知其中继地址之前（A257），`relay_ip` 和 `public_ip` 只能在随之列出的端口上访问，不能在服务器的中继端口上访问：同一服务器的两个客户端经由一方的中继地址和另一方的 server-reflexive 地址互相中继。
